description: This file defines the code-behind for the UserProfile page in an online examination system. It retrieves and displays user details from a SQL Server database based on the session's user ID, and handles navigation between pages such as Dashboard, Leaderboard, and Courses. It also manages logout functionality.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the user profile page, managing user data retrieval and navigation events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves user data from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login page.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle profile button click but currently contains commented-out code.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Taken Courses page.
